evidence.observation: Menu modal 'Spider-Man: Rooftop Rush'; Enter (InputEventAction confirm, tick 150) starts play.
evidence.riff: Enter starts; one key, no extra screens.

evidence.observation: Holding right runs; jump at tick 185 lands on the small step.
evidence.riff: Movement tuning is the starter's; only the look changed.

evidence.observation: Player contacts the parked taxi at x=320.9; 'Watch the taxis! You landed on a cab full of civilians.' overlay; RETRIES 01.
evidence.riff: Spikes became cabs; the kill zone is the cab outline.

evidence.observation: 0.57 s after contact the player respawns at x=64, RETRIES stays 01.
evidence.riff: Cheap retry: back in half a second.

evidence.observation: move_left for 18 ticks: sprite mirrors and idles facing left; later faces right again.
evidence.riff: The whole drawing mirrors via one transform.

evidence.observation: Esc opens 'Take a breath.'; the timer and taxis freeze; Enter at tick 800 resumes.
R at tick 880 returns to the start; RETRIES stays 01 (not a death).
evidence.riff: Manual restart isn't counted as a death.

evidence.observation: Leaves the floor at tick 1136 without jumping; press at 1140 (4 ticks late, window 6) and the jump fires at 1142 (input log).
evidence.riff: Coyote time forgives a late press.

evidence.observation: With the air jump spent, a press at tick 1208 while airborne fires a jump on landing at 1212 (buffer window 6).
evidence.riff: Buffer forgives an early press, once the web-zip is spent.

evidence.observation: With no air jump left, the ground jump hits the first tower's wall below its roof (y 246) and falls: 'Missed the landing'; RETRIES 02.
evidence.riff: 53 px jump vs a 74 px tower: the source numbers predict this.

evidence.observation: Falling below fall_y 430 triggers 'Missed the landing / Straight down onto the civilians below.'
evidence.riff: Falling and taxis give different messages.

evidence.observation: Second press in the air at tick 1546; web line from the wrist to the ceiling; lands on the glass tower (new landing 1).
evidence.riff: One air jump, visible as a web to the ceiling.

evidence.observation: Crossing x=512 shows the 'Afternoon · 02 MIDTOWN CROSSING' banner and the sky blends to day; the banner overlaps the hero (observed defect).
evidence.riff: Zone banner informs but can cover the player.

evidence.observation: Taxis patrol the Manhattan rooftops with headlights leading; the route passes between them.
evidence.riff: Traffic is timed off the attempt clock, so retries replay it.

evidence.observation: Web-zip at tick 1762 onto tower two (x 1328); again at tick 1961 onto tower three (x 1860).
evidence.riff: Two more landings that only the web-zip reaches.

evidence.observation: Vulture flaps across the Queens sky; Goblin and Doc Ock appear in later zones (decorative, no collision).
evidence.riff: Background characters animate but can't hurt you.

evidence.observation: Reaches the flag at x=2385 (tick 2184): 'You're Amazing, Spider-Man.' with this attempt's time and 2 retries.
evidence.riff: Timer covers the last attempt only.

evidence.observation: Real cursor warped to the PLAY AGAIN button (HUD 319.6, 214.6) and left-clicked at tick 2604; fresh session at tick 2606, RETRIES 00.
Esc then M (tick 2816) returns to the main menu modal.
evidence.riff: Back to the menu from pause.
